project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-11. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 3 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment completed 2026-08-11: 10 of 11 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; unresolved entries were individually checked and retained as unknown.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Kirby Muxloe qualifies as a local detour through Kirby Muxloe Castle and CHURCH OF ST BARTHOLOMEW. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Kirby Muxloe: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Kirby Muxloe offers Kirby Muxloe Castle, CHURCH OF ST BARTHOLOMEW within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Kirby Muxloe Castle
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Kirby Muxloe Castle and CHURCH OF ST BARTHOLOMEW, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
